edges.reason: Constructor loops over payees and invokes _addPayee for each entry.
payees array feeds the constructor initialization loop.
shares_ array feeds the constructor initialization loop.
Loop counter i drives iteration over payees in the constructor.
payees[i] is passed as account into _addPayee.
shares_[i] is passed as shares_ into _addPayee.
_addPayee writes _shares[account] = shares_.
_addPayee pushes account onto _payees.
_addPayee accumulates shares into _totalShares.
_addPayee stores shares_ in _shares mapping.
release reads _shares[account] to validate and compute payment.
_shares mapping is read inside release.
_released mapping is read inside release to deduct prior withdrawals.
_totalReleased is read to compute totalReceived.
_totalShares is read to compute the payment proportion.
release computes totalReceived = balance + _totalReleased.
payment is computed from totalReceived * _shares / _totalShares - _released; scaling arithmetic can truncate or overflow.
_shares[account] multiplies totalReceived in the payment calculation.
_totalShares divides the scaled product in the payment calculation.
_released[account] is subtracted from the computed proportion.
release updates _released[account] with the payment before transfer.
release accumulates payment into _totalReleased before transfer.
Computed payment is passed as the value to Address.sendValue.
account argument is the ETH recipient of Address.sendValue.
release performs an external value transfer to a caller-supplied address, transferring control flow out of the contract; effects are written before the call.
Address.sendValue forwards value to the account and can re-enter the contract through a malicious recipient.
tokenRescue gates execution on shares(msg.sender) > 0, making the caller-supplied address the access control subject.
msg.sender is passed to the shares() getter as the authorization check in tokenRescue.
tokenRescue calls shares() to validate caller authorization.
tokenRescue calls totalShares() to compute each payee's proportion.
tokenRescue calls payee(i) while iterating _payees.
The caller-supplied token address is used throughout tokenRescue.
tokenRescue reads the contract token balance via token.balanceOf.
amount is multiplied by shares and divided by totalShares when computing each payout, which can truncate.
shares(payee(i)) * amount / totalShares() payout arithmetic in tokenRescue.
Loop counter i drives iteration over _payees in tokenRescue.
_payees.length bounds the tokenRescue distribution loop.
tokenRescue invokes tokenTransfer for each shareholder payout.
token address is forwarded into tokenTransfer.
recipient address (payee) is passed into tokenTransfer.
Computed per-payee amount is passed into tokenTransfer.
tokenTransfer forwards the token to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
tokenTransfer forwards the recipient to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
tokenTransfer forwards the amount to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
safeTransfer performs an external call to a caller-supplied ERC20 token contract during distribution, enabling callback into the contract.
tokenRescue reaches an external token call via tokenTransfer, exposing state during iteration over payees.
receive emits PaymentReceived with _msgSender() (msg.sender).
msg.sender can trigger release for a payee address under its control.
